proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The item fits existing magic-item mechanics, but the surface cannot encode who is eligible to attune to it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Requires Attunement by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

notes: Authored as a composite magic item: passive held fire resistance plus a held charge-pool activation for Burning Hands, Fireball, and Wall of Fire. JSON typechecks and tracer succeeds. The only omitted rule text is the class-limited attunement gate.
